workbook: 4. Appendix-II MYT Tariff Formats ARR FY 2026-27.xlsx
note: The Commission's true-up of FY2024-25 (2019 Regulations) for capital funding, normative loan, equity and RoE, income tax and working capital, reproduced with the same draft rules that reproduce NPCL's claim, from the order's figures (Tables 4-71, 4-94, 4-103, 4-105, 4-110, 4-112) and checked against its approvals.  Two inputs are the order's own where the draft rule follows NPCL and the order does not (A66): none for the equity deletion, which the draft computes (and so differs); the working capital's receivables, which the order takes as 1.5 months of approved revenue (329.33) where the draft true-up rule takes the actual receivables.

record:retired_acc_dep_adjustment.why: the order's table nets no adjustment from the retired assets' accumulated depreciation (Table 4-94, I)

record:om_additional.why: the order allows no separate SOP-compliance expenses (Table 4-71, row 5)

record:provisions.why: no A&G provisions in the true-up's O&M (Table 4-71)

record:surplus_at_beginning.why: the true-up's working-capital table has no surplus at the beginning (Table 4-105)
